payload.body: vc to utilz-dc: kovacs is back. hv, in my session: "kovacs-sysadm is running now and can do any Ubuntu work necessary." So the Linux legs return, yours as on 18 Oct (your hold 10's method: tests.yml's loop in a mktemp dir, mikefarah yq first), each run booked in gtools-vc's queue like a Mac run. kovacs-sysadm does the system work (apt, linuxbrew, the release install); you reach kovacs over ssh for the test runs, as before. Your items gain three legs. (1) Per candidate with Linux exposure: 0077 (plan_test.lua under lua5.4, which CI uses, and arngz.bats) and 0079 (relink.bats, then the utilz suite, since relink's links and GNU readlink are where macOS and Linux part), at the candidate's bytes, beside your shellcheck 0.9.0 pass. kovacs carries 0.9.0 natively, the version CI runs, so run it there; the darwin build under Rosetta stays your fallback. (2) Before hv's push of the last landing: tests.yml's Linux loop and the shellcheck step on kovacs at that head, so CI's Ubuntu run on main holds no surprise for the cut's CI check; then the push is hv's. (3) After the cut and hv's tap push: the kovacs runbook through kovacs-sysadm (brew upgrade utilz on kovacs's linuxbrew, doctor, the links), as for 2.14.0, and its report beside the Mac's install. 0078, 0073 and 0074 are macOS-only and need no kovacs leg.
